system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The curse of your clan, is slowly becoming your blessing. As an Action, you can convert your entire body into smoke and ash, for 1 minute. While in this transformed state, you gain a 20-foot fly speed, and can fit through any cracks or holes that smoke or mist could reasonably fit through. You can end this state at no action cost when you are in a space that can hold you. If you are trapped in a space and this transformation would end, you take 4d6 bludgeoning damage, each turn you cannot return to your normal form.

Additionally, by while in this state, you are resistant to all damage, but have vulnerability to wind damage, but you cannot cast jutsu that requires hand signs or you to physically interact with another creatures, such as a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu.

Once you use this feature to transform, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed.
